title: A semi-smooth Newton method for the nonlinear conic problem with generalized simplicial cones
summary: In this work we develop and analyze a semi-smooth Newton method for the general nonlinear conic programming problem. In particular, we study the problem with a generalized simplicial cone, i.e., the image of a symmetric cone under a linear mapping. We generalize Robinson's normal equations to a conic setting, yielding what we call the conic projection equations. The resulting system is equivalent to the KKT conditions associated with the nonlinear conic programming problem.
